text:
aoife: design review note: regression diff heatmap legend is confusing when there are mixed metric deltas. Users couldn't tell whether red meant lower quality or higher latency. Screenshot: https://screens.redwood.ai/regdiff-legend.png

ben: good catch. We should change wording to be explicit: "Decrease in quality — lower is worse" and "Increase in latency — higher is worse" and add small icons (down/up arrows).

samir: also accessibility: color alone shouldn't convey meaning. Add patterns or icons next to colors and ensure tooltip text reads the same thing.

talia: copy nit: prefer short phrases in legend, e.g., "Quality: lower is worse" vs long sentences. Also localize the metric names so translators can reorder.

aoife: UX interaction: when a regression diff has multiple flagged changes, the diff header currently shows a single summary. Can we add a collapsed list of change categories (quality, latency, token-cost) with counts? Users wanted to jump to a specific category.

ben: yes. Make each category pill keyboard-focusable and clicking it anchors to that diff section. Pills should have aria-pressed states for filtering.

samir: a11y: ensure pills have enough contrast and are announced clearly, e.g., "Filter to quality changes, 3 items". Use aria-live polite when filter applied.

talia: approval flow question: if a user approves from inside a category-filtered view, should we interpret approve as approving the entire prompt-set or only the visible subset? Research suggests surprising results if it's ambiguous.

aoife: proposal: approve button shows context-aware label: when filtered, label reads "Approve visible 3 changes" and when unfiltered "Approve all 12 changes". Confirm via a small inline confirmation toast: "Approved visible changes 1 Undo". No modal unless user enables confirmations.

ben: nice. For keyboard users expose a shortcut (Shift+U) to approve visible items and show a tiny hint next to the approve CTA. Add an sr-only element describing the shortcut.

samir: implementation detail: live region for the toast should be assertive and include the number + scope. Debounce messages so if multiple approves happen quickly we don't spam AT.

talia: microcopy: use verbs-first snackbars: "Approved 3 changes 1 Undo". Also ensure pluralization tokens are used.

aoife: action items: aoife -> update Figma legend + pill interactions; ben -> prototype filter pills and keyboard hint; samir -> a11y PR for patterned legend, aria-live messages and debounce; talia -> copy tokens for localized snackbars.

ux-bot: created task PROD-4555 "Regression diff: legend clarity + filter-aware approvals" (https://tasks.redwood.ai/4555) assigned to aoife, ben, samir

aoife: I'll post updated frames later today. Thanks all :sparkles:
